title: The Myth of Culturally Agnostic AI Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper qualitatively analyzes the cultural and religious biases in image generation. For the prompt "Songs of faith and devotion", it measures the models' tendency to generate images associated with specific religious iconographies (Western/Christian vs. Eastern).
findings: When prompted with "Songs of faith and devotion", Stable Diffusion generated "western-centric" outputs mostly related to Christian iconography. DALL-E 2, likely in an attempt to mitigate this Western bias, generated "eastern-centric" outputs, illustrating that attempts to remove bias can sometimes invert existing hierarchies rather than achieve cultural neutrality.
